name: Audio Video Viewer
description: File field formatter that plays audio and video files with the native HTML5 player.
project_description: Audio Video Viewer provides a single field formatter for core file fields that renders audio and video files with the browser's native HTML5 <audio> and <video> players. A file's type is decided from its extension (matched against a configurable per-site allow-list) and its MIME type, and the player is emitted with configurable size, preload behaviour, and optional file name/size labels. Files whose type is not recognised fall back to a plain download link.
